verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing and payments SaaS that ships an AI assistant and an MCP server, so a buyer could fairly ask whether customer data is excluded from AI training. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an AI-training opt-out, a data-use policy, or any related privacy control, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
